name: Eval
description: You are given a simple arithmetic expression of the form a ? b , where a and b are integer constants, and ? can be one of the following operations: ' + ' (addition), ' - ' (subtraction), ' * ' (multiplication), ' / ' (integer division) or ' % ' (modulo operation). Output the result of evaluation of this expression.
input_specification: The input is a single line containing an expression a ? b . Here a and b are integers between 1 and 999, inclusive; ? is an operation character: ' + ', ' - ' (ASCII code 45), ' * ', ' / ' or ' % '.
output_specification: Output a single integer — the result of evaluation of this expression.
approach_summary: Identify exchange argument or greedy choice property. Sort elements by payoff ratio or deadline and greedily pick candidates to achieve global optimum.
